extract: Food Inspections, inspection_date from 2024-06-03 up to but not including 2024-06-10, ordered by inspection_id. 411 rows.

questions.question: How many inspections are there for each result?
questions.how: Counted the results column on all 411 rows. Those six labels are already consistent.

questions.question: How many inspections with result Fail are there for each risk level?
questions.how: Kept rows whose results value is Fail, then counted risk. 67 + 6 + 2 = 75, which matches the Fail total.

questions.question: How many inspections are there for each facility type? Treat a type written in all capitals or all lowercase as the same type in title case, so TAVERN is Tavern and banquets is Banquets. Do not count rows with a blank facility type.
questions.how: Title-cased labels that were entirely upper or lower case. Left mixed-case labels as written. Dropped 3 blank facility types. 408 inspections remain.
